metadata.task_name: Dead Code and Debug Output Cleanup Audit

execution.coverage: 100% — all four primary target files plus shared.service.ts, input-field.component.ts, LifecycleUserExits.ts also analyzed

finding.preliminary_assessment: FieldComponent constructor contains two active (not commented-out) console.log() calls that output field.content and field.visualContent on every field construction. In a terminal emulation SPA, every screen change triggers FieldComponent construction for all visible fields — meaning all terminal screen data (potentially including account numbers, PINs, passwords in masked/visual form, user names, and session context) is continuously logged to the browser console. This is the highest-risk debug output in the codebase because of frequency (every field render) and sensitivity (all terminal data). Additionally: GXUtils has 7+ global mutable static arrays (typeAheadCharacterArray, pagesArray, etc.) shared without synchronization. screen-processor.service.ts is clean (no debug output or dead code). VULN-016 dead URL constants verified as fully removed.

patterns_observed: Two active console.log() in FieldComponent constructor — logs ALL terminal screen field data
Four active console.log() in MacroComponent (lines 231, 235, 239, 272) — macro names and API responses
Large blocks of commented-out methods in SharedService (8 methods including sendData, getSharedData)
Commented-out getPattern() in InputFieldComponent — security-relevant validation logic
Commented-out enum GXDataTypesAllowedChars in InputFieldComponent — regex patterns
Commented-out import and example in LifecycleUserExits — cross-file dead-code dependency
GXUtils global mutable statics: ENABLETYPEAHEADFLAG, typeAheadCharacterArray, pagesArray
VULN-016 verified: MACRO_BASE_URL, GET_MACROLIST_URL, MACRO_URL fully removed from GXUtils
screen-processor.service.ts is clean — no debug output or dead code

false_positives.rationale: These are intentional vulnerability-fix documentation markers, not dead code — must be preserved
Inline explanatory comments (// VULN-011) are documentation, not dead code

analysis.coverage_assessment: Complete — all four primary targets plus 3 additional files. VULN-016 dead URL removal verified. screen-processor.service.ts confirmed clean.

for_inquisitor: Remove console.log() from FieldComponent constructor immediately — data sensitivity is high
Remove or gate MacroComponent console.log() calls behind production build flag
Remove all commented-out dead code blocks in SharedService — reduces regression risk
Document or deprecate getPattern() removal rationale in InputFieldComponent
